name: P(pass in this zone passage)
target: passed: this car passed the car that was ahead at zone entry, between zone entry and zone exit + 8 s (overtakes feed)

feature_definitions.gap: gap_entry, seconds to the car ahead at zone entry (intervals feed, latest reading)
feature_definitions.tyre_delta: own tyre age minus the car ahead's, laps (stints feed); NaN -> 0
feature_definitions.own_dep: 1 if this car drew >= 0.12 MJ inside the zone (ESTIMATED), else 0
feature_definitions.rival_dep: same for the car ahead, same zone same lap (ESTIMATED); NaN -> 0
feature_definitions.next_km: metres from this zone's exit to the next zone's entry, /1000, capped 6
feature_definitions.is_last: 1 if this is the final zone of the lap

preprocessing: none: raw units, no scaler, no encoder. NaN handling as stated per feature.
output: probability in [0,1] via 1/(1+exp(-x.b)), x prefixed with a 1.0 intercept column
